publication.title: MemAgent: A cache-inspired framework for augmenting conversational Web Agents with task-specific information

name: MemAgent: A cache-inspired framework for augmenting conversational Web Agents with task-specific information
notes: The Memory Cache Bank uses time-based expiration policies. The authors report 22.4% fewer average conversation turns and a 58% reduction in completion time for recurring tasks in a study with 15 participants.
summary: MemAgent adds a cache for task-specific information to conversational web agents, separating information gathering from execution across 150 web tasks.
